title: Fearless Residual Architecture Deepening
problem: Post-AI-SDK seam review found five remaining shallow Modules: registry provider metadata/factory wiring, OpenAI-compatible message dialect conversion, bridge request normalization, provider contract/public path harnesses, and the ADR-0008 ContentPart root compatibility move.
objective: Deepen all five residual seams into named Modules with smaller Interfaces, stronger locality, focused tests, changelog/evidence tracking, and justified deletion of obsolete pass-through code.
gates: cargo fmt --check -p siumai-registry -p siumai-protocol-openai -p siumai-bridge -p siumai-spec -p siumai-core -p siumai
cargo nextest run -p siumai-registry -p siumai-protocol-openai -p siumai-bridge -p siumai-spec -p siumai-core -p siumai --no-fail-fast

evidence.summary: Improve-codebase-architecture report identified registry descriptor, OpenAI-compatible message dialect, bridge codec, provider contract harness, and ADR-0008 ContentPart root move candidates.
Opened the durable residual architecture deepening workstream, task ledger, gates, handoff, and workstream index entry.
Registry built-in provider default-model lookup, factory resolution, enabled-factory registration, and provider catalog projection now cross named provider descriptor seams.

OpenAI-compatible chat message dialect conversion now lives in utils::message_dialect with dialect-local tests for OpenAI Chat, OpenAI-compatible, Perplexity, DeepSeek, xAI, and Mistral while keeping utils::* compatibility re-exports.

Bridge request JSON normalization now delegates to per-wire-format codec modules for OpenAI Responses, OpenAI Chat Completions, Anthropic Messages, and Gemini GenerateContent while preserving public bridge helper functions.
Provider contract and public-path parity tests now use named family override scenarios, provider module manifests, and a built-in registry harness for shared public-path setup.

continue_policy.notes: Continue through FRAD tasks in dependency order. Split only concrete provider/protocol follow-ons that prove a narrower scope. Hajimi adapter changes remain out of scope.
